channel.title: Brazil Procurement HOT
channel.description: Government tenders from Brazil's national procurement portal PNCP across eight categories — health, education, works, transport, food, IT, services and supplies. Titles and one-line summaries are rewritten in our own words, with links to the official notices, updated every 30 minutes.

item.title: Lauro Müller (SC) Transport & vehicles procurement · electronic pregão (reverse auction) · closes Nov 23 #PE 251
item.description: A public buyer in Lauro Müller (SC) is procuring vehicles, transport or related equipment and services through electronic pregão (reverse auction), with an estimated value of about R$ 580,459; proposals close Nov 23, 08:30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
